'''PhatKraKr Fear Must Keep Them In Line!!!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[PhatKraKr]]
* '''Published:''' 16 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Imperial City|SE-D-coruscantimperialcity.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Coruscant: Imperial City
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Coruscant Imperial City PhatKraKr.txt |Download]]

Make the Rebel’s pay a hefty tax for your control over the galaxy

== Strategy ==

*this version of Coruscant is from the Coruscant expansion set
Starting with BR (v) gives me the ability to pull Force Pikes, and the other Chr Weps.  BFHI slow the opponent’s deployment of mains.  SSPFT slows enemy force retrieval and limit their starship movement.  ITFB hurt the opponent space and better yet their ground a lot, but they could also use it against me.
Ideal situation of what I wish explain: Royal Guard armed w/ Force Pike at a related site of a planet I occupy, Royal Guards are Defense Value 5!!!!, and Kir Kanos is a 6.  For FWKTIL to work the battle ground systems must be contolled by a star destroyer, Rendili StarDrive presents the perfect solution:
VC Star destroyers deploy -2
Heavy Turbolasers deploy free and Wep Destinies are +1
TINT & OE limit the opponents chances of canceling my effects, Death Squadron is simply awesome (especially when X= all of your starship), Reactor Terminal slims out my hand after drawing, and overseeing it personally increases force drain where ever the Boss man may be.
Overall goal is to get control w/ VCSD and let the Emperor tag along with your guards.
And Fear Should Keep Those Rebel Scum In Line.
